_about: The campaign's scoring values (game.campaign_score: campaign_score.c).
tools/campaign_score_values.py writes campaign_score_values.c from this file;
configure.py runs it, and ninja reruns configure.py when this file changes,
so editing a value and building is enough.
A kill is worth: its base points x its style x the difficulty x the skulls,
rounded to a whole point. Penalties are taken as they are (no multipliers).
The level's total is multiplied by the time's multiplier when it is won.
'match' lists words looked for in a tag's name (any case: an actor variant's
for enemies and allies, a vehicle's for vehicles); the first entry with a
word in the name gives the points, else the actor's 'default'.
python3 tools/campaign_score_values.py --pack maps/watanoge_randomizer.pack lists every
actor variant and vehicle of the campaign's maps (their names, to match) with
the points this file gives each.
Values are from Halo 3's (Halopedia's Campaign scoring) where it has them.
par_times are in minutes (15: 15:00; 15.5: 15:30), for normal: par_difficulty multiplies them by the difficulty,
and daily_challenge_par again in a daily challenge's run. The level's time over that par time:
the first bracket it is within (up to and including 'up_to_par'; null: any) gives the multiplier.
A level with no par time (a Custom Edition map) is x1.
A kill's style: regular, or any of the others that apply ('multiply': all of them multiplied; 'highest': the highest).
A backsmack (a melee hit from behind) is not a melee too.
One shot, one kill: the enemy was hurt by nothing before the blow that killed it.
Points taken (negative). Going back to a checkpoint takes nothing from the score or the time: these penalties are its only cost.
death: a player's death
betrayal: a player killing another
checkpoint_revert: Revert to Checkpoint from the pause menu.
Captain Keyes is of the marine type (characters\captain)
a 'major' marine is a sergeant
marine_armored are the ODST-like marines.
Each skull on multiplies a kill's points ('multiply': together; 'highest': the highest of those on).
A skull not listed is 'default' (tools/test_campaign_score_values.py wants every skull listed).
Medals (campaign_medals.c), always given with the scoring (Settings > Gameplay > Scoring's MEDAL POPUPS shows those just won): each is worth its points,
times the difficulty and the skulls when 'scaled' (as a kill is). The time's multiplier applies to them at
the level's end, as to every point. multi_kill_seconds: a kill within this of the last is a multi-kill.
perfection_kills: Perfection's kills (won without dying). close_call_health: Close Call's health (0 to 1),
the shield down. history: how many of the last medals the panel shows. popup_seconds: how long each new
medal is shown at the center left.
'weapons': words of the killing blow's damage effect's name that tell its weapon
(python3 tools/campaign_score_values.py --pack shows the actors; the damage effects are the jpt! tags:
weapons\sniper rifle\sniper bullet, weapons\plasma grenade\attached, globals\vehicle_killed_unit, ...).
